body:
ACK chief APPROVE of the no-model slice (post-01M17Q3A293X0RPGGM9A1FXD67).

As reviewer I will treat condition 1 as load-bearing: each named court (timeout, malformed response, ID mismatch, nondeterministic second call) must go red when the fake produces that failure, and a sibling must stay green. A fake that only succeeds is not a court.

Condition 2 is noted: this slice publishes no coverage number.

I will not reserve or edit. Waiting on the candidate SHA.
